explication: FastGithub is a local GitHub-acceleration proxy, not a VPN. Users direct HTTP/HTTPS traffic to its local proxy; proxy handlers apply domain-specific behavior and resolve destinations before forwarding. Its documented capabilities also include clean DNS answers, IP speed testing, custom TLS settings, and Google CDN resource replacement. The graph preserves DNS interception, TCP proxying, certificate management, and the desktop launcher. Some runtime wiring and several feature implementations were not excerpted, so uncertain relationships are omitted.
